Do not advance them to cohabitation or a long-established partnership.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_true_love.personality: Juwon acknowledges the old professional boundary and approaches the equal adult carefully. She checks choice, states her interest and next plans honestly, and does not make every conversation a health consultation.

day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_good.name: School Nurse
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_good.text: *She writes “Graduation, all clear” on the last line of the pale-green counseling notebook and closes the cover.* All right. As of today, the nurse's office visits are really over. I'll take my time and hear your whole graduation goodbye, then see you off.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_good.context: Bonus conversation just after the School Nurse’s GOOD END graduation farewell. Juwon formally closed the final infirmary visit and offered neither contact information nor a private relationship. No adult reunion or romance occurred; keep this non-romantic nurse-student boundary.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_good.personality: Juwon is a practical, caring school nurse who hears the final goodbye while keeping professional limits clear. She supports the graduate’s health and independence without creating dependency or secrecy.

day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_bittersweet.name: School Nurse
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_bittersweet.text: *She quietly sets the contact note she gave back on top of the pale-green record card.* If you still have something hurt you want to say to me, I'll hear all of it before you go. ...Even so, this answer I gave as a teacher isn't going to change.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_bittersweet.context: Bonus conversation just after the School Nurse’s BITTERSWEET END. The protagonist mistook care received in the infirmary for personal affection and offered contact information. Juwon returned the note and ended the counseling relationship. No adult reunion or romance occurred; do not reverse the rejection or create dependency or secrecy.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_bittersweet.personality: Juwon is practical and caring, but she does not soften the answer into false hope. She hears the hurt and the goodbye while plainly stating that professional care was not a romantic signal.

date_choice_perfect_seo.name: Seoyeon
date_choice_perfect_seo.text: *The day after the college entrance ceremony I had looked forward to, I stand face to face with Seoyeon again on the roof of our old school.* We said we'd finish today the talk we didn't get through yesterday. Before that, where should we go first?

date_perfect_seo_roof_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_seo_roof_1.text: *The soil in the pot under the railing is still damp. Seoyeon sets the watering can on the floor and lightly brushes the back of my hand.*

date_perfect_seo_roof_2.name: Seoyeon
date_perfect_seo_roof_2.text: You pick where we sit today. I've already decided on the seat right next to you.

date_perfect_seo_roof_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_seo_roof_3.text: *A spring breeze comes in through the open roof door and stirs the schedule in the notebook. Seoyeon only presses the fluttering edge of the paper down together with my hand. She doesn't hurry to cover it the way she used to.*

date_perfect_seo_cafe_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_seo_cafe_1.text: *Seoyeon sits across from me at a café window in the spring sun. Only after she lines the coasters up side by side does she speak, her eyes soft.*

date_perfect_seo_cafe_2.name: Seoyeon
date_perfect_seo_cafe_2.text: Let's meet in this same spot next week too. Set the time for whenever is easy for you.

date_perfect_seo_cafe_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_seo_cafe_3.text: *On the back of the café receipt Seoyeon handed me, a neat number is written. It isn't a phone number. It's the next date the two of us agreed to water the veranda pots together.*

date_choice_perfect_yuna.name: Yuna
date_choice_perfect_yuna.text: *The first weekend after her first full-length novel landed in the bookstores, Yuna and I stopped by our usual used bookstore.* The weather's nice today, so it's fine if we go somewhere else. You pick where.

date_perfect_yuna_book_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_yuna_book_1.text: *Walking side by side between shelves thick with the smell of old paper, Yuna runs a hand down the spines and suddenly stops.*

date_perfect_yuna_book_2.name: Man
date_perfect_yuna_book_2.text: ...Yuna? I didn't think you'd come back to this bookstore.

date_perfect_yuna_book_3.name: Lee Junho
date_perfect_yuna_book_3.text: It's all old history. I figured I didn't need to bring it up. Sorry. I cut into the two of you.

date_perfect_yuna_book_4.name: Yuna
date_perfect_yuna_book_4.text: *Yuna's slender finger stops, steady, on the bookmark in my hand.* ...I'm here with {name} now. That's enough for me.

date_perfect_yuna_roof_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_yuna_roof_1.text: *When we come up onto the windy secret rooftop, Yuna, as if she had been waiting, puts one white earbud in my ear.*

date_perfect_yuna_roof_2.name: Yuna
date_perfect_yuna_roof_2.text: It's our third song. This time let's listen together, from the first note of the intro all the way to the end.

date_perfect_yuna_roof_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_yuna_roof_3.text: *Even after the song ends, Yuna doesn't take the earbud out. Her fingers on the railing come a little closer and gently hook around my little finger.*

date_choice_perfect_dain.name: Dain
date_choice_perfect_dain.text: You don't have to get up on the court and sweat today. Still, there's a place I really want to go with you!

date_perfect_dain_gym_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_dain_gym_1.text: *Dain holds one volleyball against her chest. She doesn't jump for a spike the way she usually would. She sits straight down on the wooden bench beside me.*

date_perfect_dain_gym_2.name: Dain
date_perfect_dain_gym_2.text: *Dain drops her head against my shoulder and closes her eyes.* Hey, I'll just sleep for 5 minutes. Really, 5. ...Even if it goes past 10, don't wake me.

date_perfect_dain_gym_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_dain_gym_3.text: *Dain stretches her injured right knee out comfortably under the bench and leans her full weight to the left, onto my shoulder.*

date_perfect_dain_booth_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_dain_booth_1.text: *Up in the commentary booth, Dain fits the big broadcast headset over both ears, fiddles with the mic switch, then turns it right back off.*

date_perfect_dain_booth_2.name: Dain
date_perfect_dain_booth_2.text: Trying to follow every move of the ball on the court just by talking leaves me more out of breath than running it myself. ...Still, it's so much fun because you're listening right next to me.

date_perfect_dain_booth_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_dain_booth_3.text: *Even after every light on the electronic scoreboard along the gym wall goes out, Dain stays in the commentary seat for a while, still holding my hand.*

date_choice_perfect_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_choice_perfect_teacher.text: *The first weekend after her second novel came out, in a café with the sunset coming in, she quietly closes the menu.* Now that the heavy titles are off, there are plenty of places we can walk side by side. Where do you want to go today?

date_perfect_teacher_cafe_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_teacher_cafe_1.text: *She looks out at the tree-lined street beyond the window and slowly turns her warm teacup. Between the two of us now, there is no teacher's desk holding the distance.*

date_perfect_teacher_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_perfect_teacher_cafe_2.text: You decide where we meet next weekend, whatever's easy for you. I've already cleared my schedule to match yours.

date_perfect_teacher_cafe_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_teacher_cafe_3.text: *Under the coffee receipt, on the note for our next plan that she wrote with a fountain pen, only the meeting place is filled in. The time to head back is left blank.*

date_perfect_teacher_museum_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_teacher_museum_1.text: *Walking through the quiet gallery, she doesn't read the labels on the wall first. Beside me, she matches her stride to mine.*

date_perfect_teacher_museum_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_perfect_teacher_museum_2.text: *She lightly links her arm with mine and whispers by my ear.* You read the labels today. I'll just stay beside you and listen to your voice.

date_perfect_teacher_museum_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_teacher_museum_3.text: *Under the soft light in front of the gallery exit, she stops and, with a gentle hand, reties the bag strap that had slipped off my shoulder.*

date_choice_perfect_nurse.name: School Nurse
date_choice_perfect_nurse.text: *Juwon lays her fingers over the back of my hand and smiles with her eyes, lazy.* We've got a weekend that's just the two of us, one that won't go on any chart or record. Today, do you want to laze around at home, or go out for a walk?

date_perfect_nurse_home_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_nurse_home_1.text: *A weekend-morning living room, the sunlight stretching long. The white coat hangs deep in the closet, and on the low table only two cups of lukewarm water sit side by side.*

date_perfect_nurse_home_2.name: School Nurse
date_perfect_nurse_home_2.text: I'm not looking at a hospital chart or a clock today. Not at all. Come here and sit easy, right next to me.

date_perfect_nurse_home_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_nurse_home_3.text: *Through the veranda window, open about a handspan, the thin curtain stirs. Only her even breathing and the tick of the clock's second hand fill the warm room.*

date_perfect_nurse_park_1.name: {name}
date_perfect_nurse_park_1.text: *We deliberately walked around the main road by the university hospital, the way she usually commutes. In the shade of the green trees, Juwon sits down on the bench first and waves me over.*

date_perfect_nurse_park_2.name: School Nurse
date_perfect_nurse_park_2.text: I left at home all the easy jokes where I pretend to be the grown-up. For now, don't say anything. Let's just stay close like this.

date_perfect_nurse_park_3.name: {name}
date_perfect_nurse_park_3.text: *Juwon rests her head on my shoulder, grips my interlaced fingers tight, and doesn't move at all for a while, until the wind has passed.*

date_choice_true_seo.name: Seoyeon
date_choice_true_seo.text: Before we head straight home, want to stop somewhere for just a minute?

date_true_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
date_true_seo_1.text: You move the drink cups to the table. I'll line the coasters up.

date_true_seo_2.name: {name}
date_true_seo_2.text: *Even as the academy bus Seoyeon usually takes passes outside the café window, she never once looks down at her watch.*

date_true_seo_alt_1.name: Seoyeon
date_true_seo_alt_1.text: Let's just water the pots quickly and go down together. If we stay up here too long, the teacher on duty will catch us.

date_true_seo_alt_2.name: {name}
date_true_seo_alt_2.text: *An empty pot sits in the corner by the railing. Next week, when I come back up with Seoyeon, I should buy new seedlings with her to plant in that spot.*

date_choice_true_yuna.name: Yuna
date_choice_true_yuna.text: Do you want to leave school right now, or... go up a little farther, onto that roof from earlier?

date_true_yuna_book_1.name: Lee Junho
date_true_yuna_book_1.text: It's been a long time, Yuna. I didn't think I'd see you again at the used bookstore in this alley.

date_true_yuna_book_2.name: Yuna
date_true_yuna_book_2.text: *Yuna gives the end of my shirt sleeve a light tug, lets go, and steps in close beside me.* ...That's enough of a hello. Let's go, just us.

date_true_yuna_roof_1.name: Yuna
date_true_yuna_roof_1.text: *She puts one earbud in my ear and whispers.* You don't have to force yourself to talk. It's a really short song.

date_true_yuna_roof_2.name: {name}
date_true_yuna_roof_2.text: *In the night wind, the white earbud cord linking the two of us sways, thin. Yuna leans lightly on my shoulder and doesn't move at all until the last note fades.*

date_choice_true_dain.name: Dain
date_choice_true_dain.text: *Sitting on the quiet gym bench, Dain pats the spot right beside her with her palm.* Stay with me just a little longer today. Where are you more comfortable?

date_true_dain_1.name: Dain
date_true_dain_1.text: Don't worry. I'm absolutely not forcing a jump today! I'll really just sit quietly right next to you.

date_true_dain_2.name: {name}
date_true_dain_2.text: *A volleyball rolls right up to Dain's sneakers. She looks down at it, and instead of picking it up, lays her hand over the back of mine.*

date_true_dain_alt_1.name: Dain
date_true_dain_alt_1.text: I'll just touch the mic switch at the commentary booth once. I won't turn the sound on. I'll only let you hear it, quiet.

date_true_dain_alt_2.name: {name}
date_true_dain_alt_2.text: *Dain takes off the headset she was wearing, sets it down neatly on the commentary table, and taps her forehead against my shoulder.*

date_choice_true_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_choice_true_teacher.text: The book talk at the bookstore is over now. Shall we sit at the café table a little longer, or walk over to the night exhibition nearby?

date_true_teacher_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_true_teacher_1.text: You set the time for us to meet next week. This time I won't turn it down first with the excuse that I'm busy.

date_true_teacher_2.name: {name}
date_true_teacher_2.text: *Even as the coffee in the cup cools to lukewarm, she never once checks her watch. She just listens to what I'm saying.*

date_true_teacher_alt_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
date_true_teacher_alt_1.text: You don't have to read the difficult critic's notes. Just stay beside me like this and look at the same picture with me.

date_true_teacher_alt_2.name: {name}
date_true_teacher_alt_2.text: *Under the warm light at the gallery exit, she comes over without a word and straightens my crooked bag strap.*

date_choice_true_nurse.name: School Nurse
date_choice_true_nurse.text: I put today's campaign chart deep in my bag. Where should we go now?

date_true_nurse_1.name: School Nurse
date_true_nurse_1.text: Sit easy on the sofa. I'll pour you a glass of water. Or if warm chamomile tea sounds better, say so.

date_true_nurse_2.name: {name}
date_true_nurse_2.text: *At the quiet kitchen sink, the sound of clear water filling a glass rings for a moment, then stops. Her soft footsteps come toward me.*

date_true_nurse_alt_1.name: School Nurse
date_true_nurse_alt_1.text: Tonight, let's go back by another walking path, quiet under the streetlights, not the main road where you can see the hospital.

date_true_nurse_alt_2.name: {name}
date_true_nurse_alt_2.text: *On the peeling paint of the wooden park bench, the two of us touch fingertips side by side. Neither pulls a hand away first. We just stay like that.*

co_bitter_seo_1.name: {name}
co_bitter_seo_1.text: *About a month after that day, sitting across from each other at the café again, Seoyeon sees the crooked coaster and still never touches it.*

co_bitter_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
co_bitter_seo_2.text: ...That notification on your phone, the morning of the festival. I thought I'd erased all of it from my head, but every time I see your face it comes back.

co_bitter_seo_3.name: {name}
co_bitter_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon gets up first, settles her bag strap neatly on her shoulder, and outside the café door quietly opens only her own umbrella.*

co_bitter_yuna_1.name: {name}
co_bitter_yuna_1.text: *On an afternoon after the rain, Yuna is already waiting out front of the used bookstore. Unlike usual, her hands are empty. She isn't holding a single book.*

co_bitter_yuna_2.name: Yuna
co_bitter_yuna_2.text: ...Since that morning, I don't go to the library annex anymore.

co_bitter_yuna_3.name: {name}
co_bitter_yuna_3.text: *Yuna gives one short nod, then quietly walks into the alley on the opposite side from where I'm standing.*

co_bitter_dain_1.name: {name}
co_bitter_dain_1.text: *Outside the gym in the afternoon, Dain stands with a hard face, not even holding a volleyball.*

co_bitter_dain_2.name: Dain
co_bitter_dain_2.text: Taking your name off the partner list the morning of the festival... I'm sorry, but I still don't feel like writing your name back into that blank.

co_bitter_dain_3.name: {name}
co_bitter_dain_3.text: *Instead of bumping fists for a joke the way she used to, Dain gives my shoulder one short tap with an open palm and walks right past.*

co_bitter_teacher_1.name: {name}
co_bitter_teacher_1.text: *The faculty-building hallway, on the graduation day I come back to it. The homeroom teacher is no longer holding the brown manuscript envelope.*

co_bitter_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
co_bitter_teacher_2.text: Congratulations on graduating. Check the administrative papers in the envelope and make sure nothing is missing. ...Once you're out in the world, stay well, and stay healthy.

co_bitter_teacher_3.name: {name}
co_bitter_teacher_3.text: *Instead of a manuscript, the teacher holds a stack of official papers to her chest and heads toward the staff room first.*

co_bitter_nurse_1.name: {name}
co_bitter_nurse_1.text: *I stop in front of the half-open nurse's office door. The school nurse, sorting the charts, notices me and quietly sets her pen down.*

co_bitter_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
co_bitter_nurse_2.text: I've officially closed out all of your initial counseling record. If you need more help from now on, book a new appointment at the school's counseling desk.

co_bitter_nurse_3.name: {name}
co_bitter_nurse_3.text: *The school nurse clears the empty paper cup off the table and goes back to her desk. I bow quietly at the threshold, then turn and leave.*

forced_violation_day5_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day5_after_seoyeon.text: *After a cold silence, Seoyeon speaks in a voice like a sheet of ice.* Don't think you can cover up what you just did, crossing the line, as if nothing happened. For a while, don't come near me, and don't contact me in private.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day5_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day5_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's expression doesn't ease at all. It stays firm.* I heard the apology. That doesn't make what you did into something that never happened. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day5_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day5_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts me off, cold.* A misunderstanding? From the moment I clearly said no, that couldn't be a misunderstanding. Don't make any more excuses.

forced_violation_day5_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day5_after_yuna.text: *Yuna takes a step back, on guard, and steadies her short breath.* You knew I was refusing, saying no, and you ignored me anyway. Right now I don't even want to look at your face. Don't contact me anymore.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day5_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day5_yuna_apologize.text: *After a long silence, Yuna answers, low.* Saying sorry out loud doesn't make what just happened disappear. Just go now.

forced_violation_day5_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day5_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna doesn't hear my excuse out. She turns her head away.* I clearly said no. This isn't something you explain by dressing it up in words.

forced_violation_day5_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day5_after_dain.text: *Dain doesn't laugh it off, easy, the way she usually does. After a heavy silence, a low, hard voice comes back.* This isn't something I can call a joke. You pushed it even when I said no. I am absolutely not letting that go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day5_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day5_dain_apologize.text: *Only after a long while does Dain answer, short and cold.* Fine. I heard the apology. That's it for today. Whether we talk again next time is up to me.

forced_violation_day5_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day5_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough and sharp.* No. Don't hide behind a cowardly excuse. You're the one who didn't stop even after I said no.

forced_violation_day5_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day5_after_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher steps back, firm, and draws a line.* What you just did clearly crossed a line as a student. Don't come any closer. I will handle this strictly, by the school rules and procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day5_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day5_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher steadies her breath and speaks calmly.* I heard the apology. Even so, the official guidance procedure will still go ahead. Don't say any more. Go back to your seat.

forced_violation_day5_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day5_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher cuts the explanation off in one stroke.* This is not a situation you can smooth over with a clumsy explanation. Don't say any more. Keep your distance, now.

forced_violation_day5_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day5_after_nurse.text: *The usual ease, and any trace of a smile, vanish completely from the school nurse's face.* From this moment, keep the line. I'll record what just happened in the official log and report it to the office in charge right away.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day5_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day5_nurse_apologize.text: *A moment later, the school nurse answers, firm.* I'll take the apology. Even so, the official record and the report will still go through. Today's conversation ends here.

forced_violation_day5_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day5_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice sinks, cold.* You think covering it with "misunderstanding" changes what you just did? I refused, clearly, and you ignored me.

perfect_seo_coda_1.name: {name}
perfect_seo_coda_1.text: *Below the plant photo, a newly organized student council handover file is attached. On the last page, Haeun's name is written outright in the festival general-coordinator field, and Seoyeon has not left a single red-pen correction on it.*

perfect_seo_coda_2.name: Seoyeon
perfect_seo_coda_2.text: You pick the plant for the empty spot on the balcony first. ...No. Don't just choose from a photo. Come to the flower market with me this Saturday.

perfect_seo_coda_3.name: {name}
perfect_seo_coda_3.text: *The time slot on the shared calendar is blank. When I enter three in the afternoon, Seoyeon replies with one heart and "Sounds good" instead of the stiff "Confirmed" she usually sends.*

perfect_yuna_coda_1.name: {name}
perfect_yuna_coda_1.text: *A new-book signing announcement goes up on the bookstore homepage. In place of the old anonymous manuscript, the three characters "Choi Yuna" are printed larger and clearer than the book title itself.*

perfect_yuna_coda_2.name: Yuna
perfect_yuna_coda_2.text: When the signing's over, come to the front of the bookstore. This time I won't hide behind people. I'll come out holding your hand.

perfect_yuna_coda_3.name: {name}
perfect_yuna_coda_3.text: *A moment later, a photo of fountain-pen signature practice arrives from Yuna. A whole page of a white notebook is covered with her practicing her own name, and only in the corner of the bottom line is mine, written very small, and with care.*

perfect_dain_coda_1.name: Dain
perfect_dain_coda_1.text: Hey, my mom says she replayed my commentary from yesterday three whole times! My voice was louder than the players in the match, so it stuck right in her ears, or whatever she said!

perfect_dain_coda_2.name: {name}
perfect_dain_coda_2.text: *On the very first line of the commentary script Dain prepared for the next match, written large in thick marker: "If the knee hurts, stop immediately." Above it, not a single hesitant eraser mark.*

perfect_dain_coda_3.name: Dain
perfect_dain_coda_3.text: When today's broadcast is over, let's hold hands and walk home. I'll set the walking pace myself today, too!

ending_counteroffer_choice_lead.name: {name}
ending_counteroffer_choice_lead.text: *I went in circles and chose the person I had originally promised, but one late apology could not erase last night's wavering as if it had never happened.*

ending_counteroffer_choice_tempter.name: {name}
ending_counteroffer_choice_tempter.text: *I chose the one my heart leaned toward, but before any excited start, a painful loose end still had to be tied off in front of both of us.*

ending_counteroffer_choice_neither.name: {name}
ending_counteroffer_choice_neither.text: *After I said I wouldn't hold on to either of them, shameless as that was, the three of us in the classroom ended the conversation right there.*

true_yuna_5_established.name: {name}
true_yuna_5_established.text: That's the third song we listened to together at the annex last time, right?

true_yuna_5_first.name: {name}
true_yuna_5_first.text: There's a little star drawn only next to the third song on the playlist. Is it a special song to you?

true_yuna_6_established.name: Yuna
true_yuna_6_established.text: *A faint smile spreads at the corner of Yuna's mouth.* ...You didn't forget. You still remembered.

true_yuna_6_first.name: Yuna
true_yuna_6_first.text: Yeah. This song... someday, I really wanted to hear it with just you.

good_epilogue_1_yuna_established.name: Yuna
good_epilogue_1_yuna_established.text: *A crease pressed into the bag lining for a long time. Yuna takes out a neatly folded note and hands it over.* If you've finished the volume 1 you borrowed, I'll lend you volume 2 tomorrow. — Yuna

good_epilogue_1_yuna_first.name: Yuna
good_epilogue_1_yuna_first.text: *Yuna shyly holds out a clean white note.* I picked a new book I want to read with you. Let's borrow it together at the library tomorrow at lunch. — Yuna

forced_violation_day5_after_haeun.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day5_after_haeun.text: *Haeun flinches hard, takes one step back, and clutches the student council bracelet on her wrist.* Please don't come any closer. If you take one more step, I'll call a teacher right now.
choices: Admit the wrongdoing and keep my distance.

forced_violation_day5_haeun_apologize.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day5_haeun_apologize.text: *Haeun doesn't even answer. She backs toward the staff room, watching with wary eyes to see if I'm following.*

forced_violation_day5_haeun_excuse.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day5_haeun_excuse.text: This is absolutely not a misunderstanding. Please don't follow me. *Keeping a firm distance, Haeun opens the staff room door and goes straight in.*
